name: control-lab
description: Design and independently verify controllers and active filters.

writes.name: experiment-step
writes.description: Read a frozen experiment, evaluate its baseline, advance bounded search by one candidate, run batch search, lock a candidate, independently verify, cancel, or re-evaluate saved observations. Batch search fills remaining candidate slots. Backend owns numeric bounds and immutable policy; execution success never implies engineering PASS.

writes.name: propose-candidate
writes.description: Propose bounded controller gains (kp, ki, kd) or active-filter components (r, c, gain), then evaluate on search scenarios. Consumes the frozen candidate budget. Cannot modify the specification, verification policy, or a locked candidate.

writes.name: project-result
writes.description: Project one saved candidate into a versioned conversation receipt. Read-only: it does not solve, lock, or change parameters. Call it after the approved propose, baseline, or search-next operation is idle. The receipt's status is unavailable, failed, unchecked, check_failed, inconclusive, or pass for these search scenarios only. A saved report is included only when a fresh check binds the current parameters; changing parameters leaves the old check in notApplicable and does not mark the new input passed. Cite the receipt citation. Do not copy its numbers into chart_render or table_render, and do not treat the receipt as device acceptance.
